notes.content:
[h3]NEW BETA MODE : [b]CRAWLING[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Toughest Terrain with Crawling Mode[/b][/p][p]Take on steep rocks and challenging obstacles with precision control designed for RC crawling fans.

[img src="https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExeHJ1d3QweGRsYm82bnFueGs0Y3ZzeGZuaGM5djVuc3BqcThkNWdkOSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/RTp5ciQ0StXxFPTq6g/giphy.gif"][/img]

[img src="https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbHk0bGQ4aW4ybHNhcHg0eWI4ZDFyNHNnd3Nna3JlNzkxcDhqYjExcSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/0sx44bI54tphu5lTag/giphy.gif"][/img]

notes.title: Demo 0.0.1 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]We're rolling out [b]Version 0.1.1[/b], bringing various [b]bug fixes, optimizations, and gameplay improvements![/b] [/h3]

Check out the details below, and let us know your thoughts in the [b]discussions[/b] section! 💬

[hr] [/hr]
[h3]🔹 General Improvements & Optimizations[/h3][list]  [*]Optimized [b]Main Menu[/b] loading and performance.[/*]  [*]Refactored [b]Skatepark[/b] environment for better performance.[/*]  [*]Improved lighting performance.[/*]  [*]Updated [b]Destroy Session Logic[/b] to ensure all active sessions are properly terminated.[/*]  [*]Implemented [b]Doppler Effect[/b] for a more immersive sound experience.[/*][/list]
[h3]🏎️ Gameplay & Racing Fixes[/h3][list]  [*]Fixed an issue where the [b]Lap Count[/b] was inconsistent between clients.[/*]  [*]Fixed an issue where the [b]Race Completion Order[/b] was incorrect.[/*]  [*]Fixed an issue where [b]player names were missing in race results.[/b][/*]  [*]Improved [b]Checkpoint Collision Handling[/b] for better accuracy.[/*]  [*]Fixed [b]player count validation[/b] to prevent incorrect session tracking.[/*]  [*]Implemented [b]Asynchronous Physics Tick[/b] on checkpoints for better performance.[/*]  [*]Fixed [b]vehicle substepping issues[/b] to improve movement accuracy.[/*]  [*]Removed unnecessary [b]bump mesh[/b] for a cleaner environment on [b]Skatepark[/b].[/*][/list]
[h3]🎥 UI & Spectator Mode Enhancements[/h3][list]  [*]Implemented [b]new Spectator Input system[/b] for smoother controls.[/*]  [*]Fixed [b]spectator-related bugs[/b] causing UI issues.[/*]  [*]Implemented [b]HUD for Spectator[/b] and [b]Warm-Up[/b] phases.[/*]  [*]Fixed missing or incorrect [b]Spectator Texts[/b].[/*][/list]
[h3]🌍 Multiplayer & Session Improvements[/h3][list]  [*]Fixed a bug where [b]the host leaving the game caused session instability.[/b][/*]  [*]Fixed an issue where [b]players leaving the game weren’t correctly handled.[/b][/*]  [*]Fixed a bug where [b]players were already in session when joining a new one.[/b][/*]  [*]Fixed an issue with [b]race complete widget not spawning properly.[/b][/*][/list]
[h3]📌 Main Menu & Lobby Fixes[/h3][list]  [*]Fixed [b]Main Menu Lobby Camera[/b] positioning and visibility.[/*]  [*]Fixed an issue with [b]vehicle selection visuals[/b] not updating in the lobby.[/*]  [*]Improved [b]Lobby Creation System[/b] to ensure correct initialization.[/*]  [*]Implemented [b]Settings Menu UI[/b] for more customization options.[/*][/list]
[h3]⚙️ Additional Fixes & Tweaks[/h3][list]  [*]Fixed an issue with [b]reversed air controls[/b] and UI misalignment.[/*]  [*]Removed [b]"P" key for Pause[/b] to prevent conflicts with input mappings.[/*]  [*]Hotfix applied to [b]level-specific issues[/b] and new input system changes.[/*][/list]
[h3]⚠️ Known Bugs[/h3][list]  [*]If [b]the Host[/b] leaves in gameplay, players cannot join any other session.    
✅ [b]Temporary Fix:[/b] Host a Lobby and leave. This will fix the join problem for now.  [/*]  [*]On the [b]Skatepark[/b] map, some [b]ramps cause vehicles to be thrown off.[/b]    
🛠️ [u]A fix for this is coming tomorrow![/u]  [/*][/list]
